_comment: Company slugs to check on each ATS. Find a slug in a company's careers URL: boards.greenhouse.io/SLUG, jobs.lever.co/SLUG, or jobs.ashbyhq.com/SLUG. Wrong slugs just log a 404 and are skipped, so delete any that 404.
notes: Startups and fast-moving companies hiring for ops, strategy, finance and AI-training roles in Canada, the US or remote. YC and Hacker News startups are pulled separately. Run node scripts/check-companies.mjs monthly.
